important_instructions: The notification announces 354 Group-C vacancies. There are 17 technical and tradesman categories. Only eligible male Indian citizens can apply for the notified trades. Online applications start on 15 November 2026. The last date is 14 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. The recruitment rally is tentatively scheduled from 18 January 2027. The age cut-off date is 1 July 2026. Age eligibility differs between the advertised trades. SC/ST candidates receive five years of age relaxation. OBC candidates receive three years of age relaxation. Ex-Servicemen relaxation applies according to the specified rules. Domicile or Permanent Residential Certificate is mandatory. Only one online application per candidate is permitted. The application fee is Rs. 100 for non-exempt candidates. SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempt from the fee. PST and PET will be conducted at Jorhat or Diphu in Assam. General male candidates must meet the prescribed 170 cm height standard unless eligible for relaxation. The PET normally requires a 5 km run within 24 minutes. Special running standards apply to eligible Ladakh-region candidates. The CBT carries 100 marks. Minimum CBT qualifying marks are 35% for General/EWS and 33% for SC/ST/OBC. The Trade Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Detailed Medical Examination is mandatory. Candidates must produce the required original documents. Mobile phones and other electronic gadgets are banned inside the recruitment premises. The recruitment authority may increase, decrease or cancel vacancies. Travel, boarding and lodging expenses must be borne by candidates. The official website should be monitored for reporting dates and further instructions.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification specifies the online registration period and tentative commencement of the physical recruitment rally. Candidates must complete their applications before the closing deadline. Important: The notification confirms that applications will be accepted online only. Applications received after 14 December 2026 at 23:59 hours will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the Directorate General Assam Rifles, Shillong, has issued the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 notification dated 3 November 2026 for 354 Group-C vacancies. The notification, published in the Employment News issue of 14–20 November 2026, provides recruitment dates, trade-wise vacancies, age limits, educational qualifications, application fee details, physical standards, selection procedures and other instructions. Official Notification: Assam Rifles Official Recruitment New Notification

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Vacancy 2026 - 354 Posts
content_sections.text: Assam Rifles has announced 354 vacancies across 17 technical and tradesman categories . The recruitment includes Warrant Officer, Havildar and Rifleman ranks in technical, mechanical, medical-support and other trades. Appendix-B of the official notification provides the reservation-wise distribution of all 354 vacancies. Ex-Servicemen Reservation: The notification earmarks 10% of vacancies in the notified trades for eligible Ex-Servicemen. If suitable Ex-Servicemen candidates are unavailable, the reserved positions may be filled by eligible non-Ex-Servicemen candidates belonging to the respective categories. The 10% Ex-Servicemen reservation is included in the published vacancies and must not be added separately to the total of 354.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for the notified Group-C positions is Rs. 100 . Eligible SC, ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempt from payment. Payment Mode: Candidates may pay through the online payment link or use the prescribed SBI bank-counter payment procedure. Applicants using bank-counter payment must upload a copy of the payment challan or receipt while completing the online application and produce the original during the recruitment rally. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against another recruitment expense.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes physical fitness, academic and technical assessments, document verification and medical examination. Online Application Submission. RFID-Based Physical Standard Test (PST). Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Initial Document Verification. Computer Based Test (CBT). Trade Skill Test. Detailed Document Verification. Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Review Medical Examination (RME), Where Applicable. Final Merit List and Training Call. Important: Candidates must qualify at each applicable stage to remain eligible for further consideration. Merely passing the physical tests or CBT does not guarantee selection.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Physical Standard Test (PST) 2026
content_sections.text: The physical standards depend on the candidate's category and the applicable regional relaxation. Specified regional categories include candidates belonging to the communities and regions mentioned in the notification, such as Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Dogras, Marathas and eligible candidates from designated northeastern, Himalayan and other regions. Weight must be proportionate to height and age according to the applicable medical standards. Important: Candidates claiming relaxed physical measurements must produce the appropriate supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Physical Efficiency Test (PET) 2026
content_sections.text: Male candidates who qualify the initial physical and document checks must complete the prescribed running test. Candidates must complete the required run within the prescribed time to qualify for further recruitment stages. The RFID-based PST/PET will be conducted at Jorhat or Diphu in Assam . The exact reporting date and further instructions will be published through the official Assam Rifles website.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Computer Based Test (CBT) 2026
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Test carries 100 marks . Candidates who qualify the physical and applicable verification stages will be considered for the written examination. Meeting the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee shortlisting for the Trade Skill Test. Candidates are shortlisted according to their merit in CBT and the number of vacancies in their respective trades and categories.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Trade Skill Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Trade Skill Test assesses the practical skills required for the selected technical or tradesman position. The notification specifies that the Trade Skill Test consists of a Computer-Based Practical Skill Test and a Trade-Specific Practical Skill Test , as applicable. The test is qualifying in nature, and no marks are awarded for the Trade Skill Test in the final merit calculation. Shortlisting is based on CBT merit in the relevant trade and category. Candidates who qualify the Trade Skill Test proceed to the applicable document verification and medical examination. The notification specifies shortlisting of approximately four candidates per vacancy for the subsequent document verification and medical assessment process, subject to the applicable trade and category provisions.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Medical Examination 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates qualifying in the recruitment stages must undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Medical examinations will be conducted according to the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination prescribed for Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles. Where permitted, candidates declared unfit may undergo a Review Medical Examination (RME) under the relevant medical procedures. Important: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed medical requirements. Passing the written examination and Trade Skill Test does not remove the medical-fitness requirement.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive pay and allowances according to the applicable salary structure for Assam Rifles personnel. The uploaded recruitment notice states that the pay scale and allowances will be admissible according to the pay scales applicable to Assam Rifles personnel. It does not provide a separate numerical pay matrix for each advertised trade. Salary Note: Applicants should not assume that Warrant Officer, Havildar and Rifleman posts have identical pay. Exact basic pay, allowances and service benefits depend on the applicable rank and appointment rules.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official Assam Rifles recruitment website from 15 November to 14 December 2026 . Official Website: www.assamrifles.gov.in Online Registration Start: 15 November 2026. Application Last Date: 14 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Only one application per candidate is permitted, and applications must be submitted online.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.assamrifles.gov.in . Open the Online Application section. Find Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026. Read the recruitment notification and eligibility conditions. Select the appropriate trade. Enter the required personal details. Provide the correct name and date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation certificate. Enter the prescribed domicile State/UT information. Provide educational qualifications, technical certificates and other details. Enter a valid mobile number and email address. Fill in the reservation and category information, where applicable. Upload any required documents as instructed by the portal. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 if not exempted. If using the prescribed SBI bank-counter payment method, upload the required challan/receipt. Review the entire application carefully. Complete the online application submission before 14 December 2026 at 11:59 PM . Download and print the completed application form. Save the payment receipt and application confirmation. Keep the printed application and required original documents ready for the recruitment rally. Important: The notification states that corrections or modifications will not be permitted after online submission. Candidates must verify their chosen trade, State/UT, category and personal details before submitting the form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready for online application and subsequent recruitment rally verification, as applicable. Class 10 / Matriculation certificate and marksheet. Class 12 certificate and marksheet, where required. ITI trade certificate, where applicable. Diploma or degree certificate for the selected trade, where applicable. Valid domicile or Permanent Residential Certificate. SC/ST/OBC certificate, where applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate and service/discharge documents, where applicable. Certificate supporting relaxed physical standards, where applicable. Valid photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photographs. Printed online application form. Application fee payment receipt or challan. Other certificates prescribed for the selected trade. Important: Original documents must be produced during the applicable physical test, documentation and verification stages. Candidates claiming any concession or reservation must possess valid supporting certificates.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has Assam Rifles advertised in this Rally?
faq.answer: 354 Group C posts across 18 technical trades, all-India, with no state-wise quota.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application deadline is 14 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Can women apply for this Rally?
faq.answer: No. All 18 advertised trades are open to male candidates only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Most trades require 18–23 years; Cipher, Draughtsman, Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist require 18–25 years, as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: RFID-based Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Documentation Verification, a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Trade Skill Test, and a Detailed/Review Medical Examination, followed by a trade- and category-wise Merit List.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 100/- for Group C posts; no fee for SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a quota for Ex-Servicemen?
faq.answer: Yes, 10% of vacancies are earmarked for Ex-Servicemen in most of the advertised trades; unfilled ESM vacancies go to non-ESM candidates of the same category.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: Online only, through assamrifles.gov.in; only one application per candidate is accepted.
